subtitle: Landmark Travel & Campus Tours
promotional_text: Explore 2,400 famous buildings in 166 cities on a 3D map, hear their stories, check step-free access and collect a stamp at each. Plus 122 college campuses.
whats_new:
New in 2.10
• 10 new cities, from Porto and Kraków to Hiroshima and Hanoi, and 5 new campuses, including the University of Tokyo. 166 cities and 122 campuses in all.
• Made for everyone: VoiceOver labels throughout, layouts that adapt to the largest text sizes, and Reduce Motion respected everywhere.
• Step-free access: see which landmarks have step-free entrances and accessible toilets.
• A new Home Screen widget in small, medium and large sizes.
• More Siri and Shortcuts: "Show my progress", "What's near me", start a walking tour or open a landmark.
• Trips, your college list, saved places and Want to Visit now sync between your devices without losing changes.
• Settings are grouped so they're easier to find.
• iPad: keyboard shortcuts for the things you do most.
description:
Stamped! turns the world's great buildings into a passport to fill. Explore more than 2,400 architectural landmarks in 166 cities and 122 university campuses, earn a stamp for every one you visit, and fly through real cities on a photoreal 3D map.

PLAN YOUR COLLEGE VISITS
• 122 campuses: every Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 school, the Ivy League, and great campuses around the world
• Save the schools you're considering to My College List
• Make a College Road Trip: a day at each school, in a short driving order
• Plan a Campus Visit: a one-day walking tour of a campus's landmarks
• Find hotels near campus for each night of your trip

CAMPUS TRADITIONS
• Over 250 campus traditions to do or see, from lucky statues to bells and famous gates
• Check them off as you go and earn the Traditions Keeper badge
• Campus stamps in school colors

PLAN ANY TRIP
• Plan several days of landmarks and your own saved places
• Reorder stops, see walking times and optimize your route
• Fly through your trip on the 3D map, day by day
• Your trips, college list, saved places and Want to Visit list sync with iCloud
• Restaurants, hotels, tours and local events around your stops
• Compare hotels on Expedia and Booking.com, or find a vacation rental on Vrbo
• Save a city for offline: its landmark photos and stories stay on your device

EXPLORE IN 3D
• Photoreal 3D city and campus maps with satellite imagery
• A guided tour that flies between every landmark
• Look Around previews of the streets before you go
• Map filters for food, coffee, culture and places to stay

COLLECT STAMPS
• Earn a passport stamp for every landmark you visit
• Follow your progress on the world map, by city, country and conference
• Unlock achievements and share your passport
• See your progress at a glance with small, medium and large Home Screen widgets
• Siri and Shortcuts: open a city, check your progress or find landmarks near you

DISCOVER THE STORIES
• Architects, build dates, styles and history for every building
• Listen: hear any landmark's story read aloud
• A 10-question architecture quiz for every city and campus
• Search by name, architect or campus nickname
• Architect pages, photo galleries and historic photos from the Library of Congress
• Step-free access and accessible toilets for 300+ landmarks

Available in 9 languages, with VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, high contrast and Reduce Motion support.

Stamped! is not affiliated with or endorsed by any university. School names and colors are used only to identify them.
